name.description: the metric's own name, e.g. Context Precision

category.description: what part of a system the metric scores

min.description: lowest value the metric takes; null when it has no lower bound

max.description: highest value the metric takes; null when it has no upper bound

direction.description: which way a better system moves the value

needs_reference_answer.description: true when the metric compares against a ground-truth answer

needs_judge_model.description: true when a model has to grade the output

related_metrics.description: IDs of metrics that measure something close to this one
